candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that adds the provided amount (betLimit = betLimit + amount), changing resulting betLimit after AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that subtracts the provided amount (betLimit = betLimit - amount), changing resulting betLimit after AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that multiplies betLimit by the provided amount (betLimit = betLimit * amount), changing resulting betLimit after AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that divides betLimit by the provided amount (betLimit = betLimit / amount), changing resulting betLimit after AdjustBetAmounts.

Replace require check requiring msg.sender == owner with requiring msg.sender != owner, allowing only non-owner callers to pass; this changes whether AdjustBetAmounts (protected by onlyOwner) can be called, thus changing observable betLimit after calls.
Replace assignment to difficulty with setting it to amount + 1 (off-by-one change).
Replace assignment to difficulty with setting it to amount - 1 (underflow guarded by Solidity 0.8 checks will revert if amount == 0).
Replace assignment to difficulty with doubling the input amount before assignment.
Remove the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts AdjustDifficulty; this exposes ability to change difficulty by non-owners.
